documents_expected.why: topic page (a single-page app; its text is in the topicDetails JSON)
work programme: topic scope, multi-actor rule, budget and deadline
general annexes: consortium rule, application parts, funding rate, reporting

eligibility.rule: Consortium of three independent legal entities in three countries, at least one in an EU Member State
eligibility.quote: only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: - at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and - at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
The proposals must apply the multi-actor approach.

eligibility.rule: Entities in China can't take part in research and innovation actions
eligibility.quote: Unless otherwise stated, legal entities established in China are not eligible to participate in any Horizon Europe Research and Innovation Action (RIA).

eligibility.rule: Public bodies, research organisations and universities need a gender equality plan
eligibility.quote: In addition, to be eligible, legal entities from Member States and Associated Countries that are public bodies, research organisations or higher education establishments

eligibility.rule: Three new living labs of 8 to 15 experimental sites each
eligibility.quote: support the set-up of three new living labs, with 8 to 15 experimental sites each

eligibility.rule: Cover at least three EU Member States or Associated Countries, including outermost regions
eligibility.quote: cover different geographical regions or climate zones and at least three different EU Member States and/or Associated Countries, including sites in outermost regions

eligibility.rule: Say which area the proposal addresses (A: risk resilience, B: agriculture and forestry)
eligibility.quote: The area (A or B) should be clearly indicated on the application.

documents.item: Part A: administrative forms and budget, filled in online
documents.quote: Part A (to be filled in directly online) contains administrative information about the applicant organisations (future coordinator and beneficiaries and affiliated entities), the summarised budget for the proposal and call-specific questions

documents.item: Part B: technical description, 40 pages at most
documents.quote: Part B (to be downloaded from the Portal submission system, completed and then assembled and re-uploaded as a PDF in the system) contains the technical description of the project.
alt_quotes: the limit for a full application is 40 pages

effort.step: Build the consortium and submit electronically through the Funding & Tenders Portal
effort.quote: All proposals must be submitted electronically via the EU Funders & Tenders Portal electronic submission system

effort.step: Submit by the deadline (call opened 13 October 2026)

consortium_required.quote: only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions

after_award.quote: There will be one or several interim payments linked to a periodic report, depending on the duration of the project. At the end of the project, the consortium will be invited to submit a report on the basis of which the final grant amount will be calculated.

notes: Open research and innovation action, lump-sum grant: EUR 60 million for about 6 projects of around EUR 10 million. Up to 30% of the budget may go to third parties through calls. Living labs network with the CSA under HORIZON-NATURE-2027-02-03. The topicDetails JSON's embedded links carry escaped quotes, so the pipeline's link extraction misses them. Deadline 17:00 Brussels time.
